tool.name: ATRIUM XML translator
tool.description: translates the text inside ALTO pages and AMČR metadata records, keeping their structure
tool.command:
#import re ## The document keeps its collection name: the translated file, the log and the record are named ## after it. Known extensions are dropped (a page from OCR keeps the image's name). #set $stem = re.sub(r'(\.alto)?\.xml$|\.(png|jpe?g|tiff?)$', '', str($document.element_identifier), flags=re.IGNORECASE) #set $stem = re.sub(r'[^\w.\-]', '_', $stem) or 'document' #if $mode.kind == 'alto': #set $suffix = '.alto.xml' #else: #set $suffix = '.xml' #end if export HF_HOME="\${_GALAXY_JOB_TMP_DIR:-\$PWD/tmp}/hf" && mkdir -p input out && ln -s '$document' 'input/${stem}${suffix}' &&
## Every setting is on the command line. The image's config.txt names paths relative to /app, ## which is not the job's working directory, so the run reads an empty one instead. python3 /app/main.py 'input/${stem}${suffix}' --config '$empty_config' -o out --backend lindat --source_lang '$source.source_lang' #if $source.source_lang == 'auto': --default-source-lang '$source.default_source_lang' #end if --target_lang '$target_lang' --output-mode '$output_mode' #if $mode.kind == 'alto': --alto --formats alto.xml $mode.fast_align #else: --formats xml #if $mode.fields.source == 'amcr': --xpaths /app/amcr-fields.txt #else: --xpaths '$mode.fields.xpaths' #end if #if $mode.xsd: --xsd '$mode.xsd' $mode.xsd_strict #end if #end if #if $vocabulary.source == 'bundled': --vocabulary /app/data_samples/vocabulary.csv #elif $vocabulary.source == 'own': --vocabulary '$vocabulary.vocabulary_csv' #end if #if $baseline: --document-json '$baseline' #end if --document-json-out record.json && ## One document per job, so each pattern matches one file. The log is named after the document's ## canonical id, which can be shorter than the file name. mv out/*_${target_lang}${suffix} '$translated' && mv out/*_log.csv '$log' && mv out/paradata/*_translator.json '$paradata' && mv record.json '$record'

configfiles.configfile: # No settings: the Galaxy tool passes them all on the command line.

param.name: document
param.label: Document
param.help: An ALTO page or an XML metadata record, such as an AMČR OAI-PMH record. For a collection, the tool runs once per document.

param.name: kind
param.label: Kind of document
param.option: Metadata record: translate the fields an XPath list names
ALTO page: translate every text line

param.name: xpaths
param.label: XPath list
param.help: One XPath per line, with the record's namespace prefixes.

param.name: xsd
param.label: XML schema to validate the result against

param.name: xsd_strict
param.label: Fail when the result does not validate
param.help: Otherwise a warning only; the translation is still written.

param.name: fast_align
param.label: Fast alignment
param.help: Fewer calls to the translation service: words are spread over a block's lines by source word count.

param.name: default_source_lang
param.label: Language when detection cannot be trusted
param.help: Text too short, low confidence, or a language the service cannot translate.

param.name: target_lang
param.label: Target language
param.help: The LINDAT translation service decides which pairs exist; a pair it lacks stops the job before anything is translated.

param.name: output_mode
param.label: How the translation is written
param.option: Keep the source text and add the translation beside it

param.name: source
param.label: Vocabulary
param.help: Terms of the vocabulary are matched by lemma (LINDAT UDPipe) and translated as the vocabulary says.
param.option: The AMČR and TEATER vocabulary in the image

param.name: vocabulary_csv
param.label: Vocabulary
param.help: A CSV with the columns source_lemma,target_translation.

param.name: baseline
param.label: Document record to add to
param.help: An ATRIUM document record from an earlier stage; the translation's blocks are added to it.

tool.help:
**What it does**
Translates the text inside XML documents and writes it back without changing their structure: the tags, attributes and coordinates stay. It runs the ATRIUM translator (`ufal/atrium-translator`_), release @TOOL_VERSION@, with the LINDAT translation service (CUBBITT) of ÚFAL, Charles University.
**Input**
- *A metadata record*, such as an AMČR OAI-PMH record: the fields an XPath list names are translated. The bundled list holds AMČR's free-text fields. - *An ALTO page*, for example from OCR: every text line is translated, and the translated words are spread back over the lines of each block.
**Languages**
With *Detect*, each line or field is identified by fastText and translated from its own language. The LINDAT service decides which pairs exist (Czech to and from English, and several languages to English); a pair it lacks stops the job before anything is translated.
**Vocabulary**
With a vocabulary, its terms are found by lemma (LINDAT UDPipe), protected during translation, and written as the vocabulary translates them. The bundled one holds the AMČR and TEATER terms.
**Outputs**
- *Translated document* (XML): named ``<document>_<target>.xml`` or ``.alto.xml`` in the history. With *Keep the source text*, a metadata field gets an ``xml:lang``-marked sibling and an ALTO line an ``<ALTERNATIVE PURPOSE="translation:<target>">``. - *Translation log* (CSV): one row per ALTO line or metadata field, with the source text, the translation and a status (``ok``, ``rerun``, ``approx_alignment``, ``untranslated``, ``unsupported_lang``). Review the rows that are not ``ok``. - *Paradata* (JSON): the run's provenance, with the components and their licences. - *Document record* (JSON): the ATRIUM document record with the translation's blocks.
**Network and licences**
The job calls the LINDAT translation and UDPipe services over the internet. The code is MIT; the fastText language-identification model is CC BY-NC 4.0; the paradata lists each component's licence.
.. _`ufal/atrium-translator`: https://github.com/ufal/atrium-translator
